overview: Uniforms are essential for professional appearance and discipline within the squadron.
exchangeProcess: Cadets with ill-fitting uniform parts can submit requests for exchange for a size that fits from the dashboard: Click Exchange at the bottom of the dashboard under Supply. Pick up will be at the Squadron Office on the Supply night. If parts are not in stock, you will be notified when they will be ready.
returnPolicy: Cadets no longer with the squadron should return their washed uniform to supply. Returns are accepted every Tuesday during regular training at Bur Oak Secondary School. Drop off the uniform on the Supply Desk and include the return form.
supplyNightNote: Cadets can drop by without advance request, but no guarantee that the uniform parts are in stock. Please bring back the washed uniform to exchange.
officeAddress: Unit 5 - 185 Riviera Dr, Markham, Ontario L3R 5J6
followUp: Cadets with outstanding supply requests are to follow up with the Supply WO.
